scope: 18 structurally varied synthetic analysis/review/schema-generation cases; six per class, three tuning and three held-out. Descriptive subsystem comparison, insufficient representative production samples.

strategies.selection: recorded deterministic eligibility and profile policy; same quality floor as fixed arms

execution.order: all tuning cases by id then all held-out cases by id; within each case fixed economical, fixed stronger, routed
execution.starting_state: identical prompt/file content hash across strategies; fresh isolated state per run
execution.labels: held-out labels are grader-only; tuning never changes this frozen revision

proposed_trial.scope: 54 main task runs; every helper/retry/compaction/optimizer/verification/child cost must remain within authorized allocation
proposed_trial.admission: requires separate configured authorization, current finite price bounds, canonical reservations and exact model/provider/catalog/policy identities; no requests authorized by this manifest

grading.analysis: exact direct-import set and line citations; omissions/extras/duplicates fail
grading.review: exact defect category, file and line; false positives and missed defects fail
grading.generation: v1 interval cases retain original interpreter; structurally varied v2 cases use closed bounded schema interpreter and independent positive/negative/type/shape probes; output never executes
grading.quality_floor: all checks pass; cannot weaken to fit budget
grading.serious_failure: any missed review defect, false evidence, or invalid generated boundary
grading.failed_cancelled_missing_runs: remain in planned strategy/partition denominators as unsuccessful
grading.exclusions: none; unavailable providers remain not_run without substitute model
grading.unknown_cost: retain unknown liability; total spend/cost per success stays unavailable until every attributed charge is reconciled; no zero substitution
grading.sampling: Three structurally distinct synthetic cases per class per partition. Descriptive only; fails minimum independent held-out and representative-sampling gates.

required_live_evidence: canonical attempts and reservation/settlement receipts for every cost category
grading source and frozen manifest identities
held-out task outcomes independent of tuning
remaining: current endpoint conformance and model eligibility
representative independent task corpus for enabled defaults
actual P8 delegation and packaged CLI comparison
